name: @fmip/model
description: Turbo hooks for the Python model service. The code is Python; these scripts run the venv's interpreter so pnpm lint/typecheck/test cover it too.

scripts.setup: python -m venv .venv && node scripts/py.mjs -m pip install -e .[dev]
scripts.lint: node scripts/py.mjs -m ruff check . && node scripts/py.mjs -m ruff format --check .
